The '''''Lusankya''''' {{C|{{Audio|Lusankya.flac|Pronunciation}}}}, originally known as '''''Executor II''''', was an [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] built by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], as the sister ship to the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], which was built at [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]].

Following its construction, the ship was buried beneath the surface of Coruscant as an emergency evacuation craft for the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]], where it served as [[Ysanne Isard]]'s private prison after his gifting it to her as a loyal supporter, and later as her command ship during the [[Bacta War]].

When Isard was defeated, the ''Lusankya'' was acquired by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic.]] It served in the New Republic fleet until its [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|destruction]] in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Lusankya-HBCE.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Lusankya'' command tower]]
The ''Lusankya'' was the second ''Executor''-class Super Star Destroyer to be constructed.<ref name="BactaWar">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref> It was 19 kilometers long, twelve times the length of an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]]. It could carry more than 5,000 weapons,<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations1">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> at least 12 [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] squadrons,<ref name="Starships of the Galaxy2">''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]''</ref> at least 200 other combat and support ships, three [[IM-455 modular garrison|prefabricated garrison bases]],<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations1" /> and enough [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] to impose the Empire's will on any star system.

The ''Lusankya'' was designed to be a variant of the ''Executor''-class, focusing more on planetary occupation without a need for supporting vessels. As such, it dispensed with some heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries in exchange for more point-defense weaponry.<ref name="SOTGSE" />

As a personal ship for the Emperor, its command quarters were extremely luxurious, featuring various furniture of exotic woods, xenoscapes with living creatures and a private library.

==History==
===Construction and placement on Coruscant===
The ''Lusankya'' was built concurrently with her sister-ship, the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. During construction, both ships were provisionally named ''Executor'' to make it appear as if only one ship were being built. However, while the ''Executor'' was commissioned into Imperial service after completion, the ''Lusankya'' was taken to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and buried beneath the planet's surface. The vessel and its repulsorlift cradle were hidden inside a superframe of girders and electronics before the burial, and were claimed to be a large power generator, one out of thousands of identical power sources on the planet.<ref name="SOTGSE" /> The cityscape was subsequently rebuilt over the ship to hide its location.<ref name="BactaWar" />

[[File:Lucy_roundel.svg|thumb|150px|[[Alliance Starbird]] symbol on the ''Lusankya'']]
Not knowing all of the details surrounding the burial, some New Republic observers later confirmed that [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] on a massive scale to command everyone to forget what they saw.<ref name="KrytosTrap">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref> As for the purpose of the burial, it was theorized that the ''Lusankya'' was meant to provide Palpatine with a secure means of escape, in case Coruscant was invaded by hostile forces. Only a select few were made aware of its existence, location, and purpose, among these being Darth Vader, and later, Ysanne Isard.<ref name="SOTGSE" />

===Ysanne Isard's private prison===
A portion of the ''Lusankya'' served as a private prison managed by [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]]. Isard was able to travel back and forth to the ''Lusankya'' by a network of private tunnel shuttles that were connected between the [[Galactic City/Legends|city]] and the ship. One of these shuttles went to the Galactic Museum, another to a 43rd-floor foyer in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], wherein her office was held, and another to an old subcommittee room in the former Imperial [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. This same prison facility served as a database or surveillance area and as Isard's secret headquarters. In interrogating the ''Lusankya''{{'s}} prisoners, Isard was ruthless, employing any means necessary&mdash;including [[Torture/Legends|torture]], [[Spice/Legends|drugs]], and psychological conditioning&mdash;to learn what she desired. She even turned prisoners, usually captured Rebels, into [[Sleeper agent/Legends|sleeper agent]]s. These agents would then be returned to their families, friends, and colleagues, where Isard would use them to spy on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], perform sabotage, and assassinate enemies.

[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] learned of the prison when the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Diktat]]'s greatest rival was murdered by his aide. The aide had been taken to the ''Lusankya'' and turned into a sleeper agent, then returned to perform the assassination. After committing the murder, the aide repeated the word "Lusankya" over and over.

Though no one outside Isard's circle knew of the ''Lusankya''{{'s}} location, it regardless came to be infamously known as Ysanne Isard's private prison. Rebel Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] was sent there following his capture shortly following the Battle of Yavin. [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] was also sent there following his capture during an espionage mission to Coruscant in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Isard tried to condition Celchu into one of her agents, but the efforts rendered him catatonic. He was eventually transferred to [[Akrit'tar/Legends|Akrit'tar]], but escaped from that facility and returned to the Rebellion. The reputation for Isard's prisoners to be sleeper agents was so strong that Celchu was not trusted by even close compatriots. During the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]] in the following year, the controls to Horn's fighter were seized by an override code and he appeared to crash into the cityscape and was presumed dead. This and other evidence pointed to Celchu, and he was branded a traitor.

However, Horn was not dead, and the events of his "crash" had been orchestrated by Isard and framed on Celchu. Horn was placed aboard the ''Lusankya'', where he eventually met Jan Dodonna. From him, Horn learned that many people washed out of Isard's indoctrination process, and were rendered [[Catatonia|catatonic]] in the process&mdash;the other prisoners referred to them as "sleepers." Horn also learned of a suspicious inconsistency within the prison: in the main cavern where the prisoners worked, a rock would "fall up" if thrown high enough. This was because the artificial gravity of the Star Dreadnought was rotated so that prisoners were in effect standing upside down, a tactic employed by Isard so if anyone tried to escape by digging "up," they would actually go deeper into the prison, making them easier to capture.

Eventually Horn was able to escape from the prison complex, during which he found a library complex on the ''Lusankya'' and discovered that not only had he washed out of the indoctrination process, but so had Celchu. With the addition of this information, he was able to deduce the identity of the [[Erisi Dlarit|real traitor]] within Rogue Squadron. After further searching, he found a blaster in the library's copy of ''[[The Complete History of Corvis Minor]]'', and a private tunnel shuttle that allowed him to leave the ''Lusankya''. The shuttle took him to a closed-off section of the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum,]] which had originally housed a display honoring Jedi Masters. Here Horn learned that he had, in fact, never left Coruscant, and also found clues to his Jedi heritage, 

===Breaking free of Coruscant===
[[File:Lusankya_escaping_Coruscant.jpg|thumb|left|250px|''Lusankya'' rises from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].]]
After Horn escaped, Isard knew that the New Republic would soon find the ''Lusankya'' and capture her if she remained. Isard had the ship break free of the planet. While leaving Coruscant, the ''Lusankya'' devastated over 259 square kilometers of the planet's surface, killing untold millions.

The ''Lusankya'' blasted its way through the two planetary shield levels, pausing to exchange fire with an orbiting [[Golan space defense platform]] before jettisoning the now exposed lift cradle with the superframe's generator, and departing the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]].<ref name="SOTGSE" />

===The Battle for Thyferra===
The ''Lusankya'' then traveled to [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] after [[Xucphra Corporation|''Xucphra'']] conducted a political coup that installed Ysanne Isard as the planetary leader. Because the New Republic was unwilling to interfere with the internal politics of a world, [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], and the other members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] resigned their commissions in the New Republic fleet and began gathering resources to continue to fight against Isard without the New Republic's support.

Upon arriving at Thyferra, the ''Lusankya'' was joined by the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial-II'' class Star Destroyers]] [[Freedom|''Avarice'']] and [[Errant Venture/Legends|''Virulence'']] and the [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Corrupter/Legends|''Corrupter'']].

Over the next few months, the Rogues slowly worked to build up their forces, while whittling down the Imperial forces to the point where the two forces could engage each other. The ''Corrupter'' was destroyed at [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] when an automated Alderaanian war cruiser, the [[Valiant (Thranta-class War Cruiser)|''Valiant'']], joined the Rogues. Commander Antilles was able to talk [[Sair Yonka]]&mdash;the Captain of the ''Avarice''&mdash;to take his ship and leave Isard's service. That left the ''Lusankya'' and the ''Virulence''.

Once Isard's forces discovered the Rogue's [[Yag-prime|space station base]] at [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]], the ''Lusankya'' and the ''Virulence'' were sent to destroy it. But when they arrived, the Rogues jumped to hyperspace, and the station appeared to be ''very'' heavily armed, with more than three hundred proton torpedo and concussion missile launcher signals. The ''Lusankya'' was caught by the station's tractor beam, but was released when the ''Virulence'' intercepted and was caught in the beam. The ''Lusankya'' retreated from the system and left her fighters behind in her haste to flee. The station ordered the ''Virulence'' to surrender or be destroyed, to which the ''Virulence'' complied after the station's gravity well projector pulled [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken's]] [[A-wing]] squadrons out of hyperspace on top of the standoff. After the ''Virulence'' crew had surrendered, the pirate in charge of the station, [[Booster Terrik]], took over the ship without firing a single torpedo. He loaded Pash's people and his own people on to the ''Virulence'' and departed for Thyferra.

The captain of the ''Lusankya'', [[Joak Drysso]], returned to Thyferra expecting a battle. However, when the ship slowed to sublight, there was nothing but normal traffic. Shortly after the ''Lusankya'' arrived, a Star Destroyer arrived in the system. It was the ''Avarice'', now renamed the ''Freedom''. The ''Freedom'' had carried the Rogues to Thyferra. The Rogues began to attack the ''Lusankya'', and when they fired a salvo of their proton torpedoes, a large salvo of torpedoes and missiles from the freighter traffic in the system hit the ''Lusankya''. Antilles had convinced a number of freighters to join the effort. They were equipped with heavy torpedoes, but were not given targeting sensors so they would not appear as hostile on Imperial scopes. Instead, the freighter's weapons were slaved to Rogue Squadron's targeting computers.

The ''Freedom'' and the ''Valiant'' also concentrated their firepower on the ''Lusankya''. The ''Freedom'' was severely damaged; however, the ''Valiant'', having been ignored by Captain Drysso, had outmaneuvered its huge opponent. The ''Valiant'' had managed to slip and remain behind the ''Lusankya'', where it could target the huge engine array at leisure; the lack of a fighter screen and the low amount of tail guns on the ''Executor''-class design allowed the ''Valiant'' to escape serious damage. Soon the ''Virulence'' appeared in the Thyferra system, but it was no longer under Imperial control. A squadron of A-Wings led by [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] had sprung upon the ''Virulence'' during its standoff with the Yag'Dhul station and had destroyed the Imperial [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighters]], and now traveled on the ship after its capture by Booster Terrik. They now launched into the fray as the ''Virulence'' turned its weapons on the ''Lusankya''.

Commander Antilles then decided to ask the ''Lusankya'' to surrender, seeing as how the starship would not last much longer. Drysso refused to surrender and seemed driven to insanity by the events of the past several days. He was preparing to ram Thyferra with the ''Lusankya'' itself, against the wishes of the crew, when he was killed by his aide. His aide, Acting-Captain [[Waroen]], surrendered the ship to Antilles. Isard had appeared to have died when Captain Celchu destroyed a shuttle that was believed to have been carrying her. Celchu credited the kill to Lieutenant Horn's targeting.

===After the Bacta War===
The ''Lusankya'' was severely damaged after the battle for Thyferra. The area where the prison was had been breached. Fortunately for the prisoners, they were not on board during the battle, as Isard had them shipped to other facilities, believing Horn's escape had ruined the previously inescapable prison.

As the ship had been surrendered to him, Wedge Antilles was the acting commander of the ''Lusankya''. In that capacity, he performed the [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] ceremony of Corran Horn and [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]], with Tycho and Iella Wessiri as witnesses. Antilles, Horn, and the rest of the squadron then rejoined the New Republic armed forces, when it was discovered an "error" had occurred which resulted in their earlier resignations failing to be formally logged in the squadron member's files. The council then passed a resolution approving what the Rogues had done, making the entire operation ''fait accompli'' for the Republic.

The ''Lusankya'' then left the [[Polith system|Thyferra system]] and was taken to a secret location, where repairs and upgrades were made. Rumors were spread that the ship was destroyed&mdash;that either the damage was such that the ship couldn't be repaired, or that the ''Lusankya'' was salvaged for parts. The ship's sharp lines were eventually restored, and two large Rebel crests were painted on its sides. The original prison complex was also removed, with a medical quarantine complex installed in its place. The secrecy over the repairs was such that even some members of the council were unaware of the ''Lusankya''{{'s}} continued existence until the military made them aware of it.

Ysanne Isard, who had slipped away from the Thyferra system at the end of the [[Bacta War]], had spent several years in seclusion. While laying low, she learned of the Emperor's return. Isard was terrified of being executed for losing Coruscant to the Rebels, and devised a strategy to win a place of honor for herself in Palpatine's [[Dark Empire|new Empire]]. She finally reappeared in an attempt to retake control of her beloved ''Lusankya'' from the New Republic to use it as a peace offering to the reborn Emperor.<ref>[[The New Essential Chronology|''The New Essential Chronology'']]</ref> By plotting the downfall of [[Delak Krennel]] and his [[Ciutric Hegemony]], Isard hoped to keep the New Republic distracted long enough for her to steal back her Super Star Destroyer. However, she was outguessed by Booster Terrik, Mirax Terrik, and [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]], who were waiting for her when she arrived. Isard attempted to kill Wessiri with her holdout blaster, but failed, as the latter returned fire and instantly ended her life.

===New Republic Service===
{{Quote|I'm not exactly going to miss you.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] on the ''Lusankya''{{'s}} destruction|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>}}
[[File:LusankyavsReaper-EGW.jpg|thumb|left|250px|''Lusankya'' engages ''Reaper'' over Orinda]]

After Isard's death, the ''Lusankya'' entered New Republic service. The ship had all but been abandoned in the [[Scarl]] shipyards, acting as a medical research facility<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> in case the Empire attempted further biological warfare after seeing the devastation done by the [[Krytos virus]] during the Liberation of Coruscant. The ship was designed with new quarantine facilities which included a containment zone where no living creature was allowed to enter. This area was serviced strictly by droids so that, if necessary, the containment zone could be destroyed with minimal loss of life.

When the surviving original prisoners of the ''Lusankya'' were freed, they, along with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], were held on the ''Lusankya'' quarantine facilities so that medical experts could confirm that neither the prisoners nor the Rogues were carrying any biological weapons within them. In addition to refitting it for biomedical operations, the New Republic also succeeded in reducing the crew requirement for the warship. Further, the ''Lusankya'' was refitted with better armor than Star Dreadnoughts still in Imperial service. Several other systems were also redesigned to take advantage of having the extra available space.

The fight against the Dark Empire had proved that nothing in the New Republic's arsenal was a match for the Empire's hordes of battleships. With [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] unable to verify that other Dreadnoughts, [[World Devastator|World Devastators]], or worse wouldn't be encountered in the future, the ''Lusankya'' was hastily refitted for active duty. The ship was placed under the command of Wedge Antilles and used as a base for the reformed, multi-fighter Rogue Squadron he had been assigned to oversee. Besides Rogue Squadron itself, over 100 other ships also assigned to its service were stationed aboard ''Lusankya''. The first mission it undertook for the New Republic was the [[Battle of Phaeda]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

[[File:LucyAgainstTheDiamondsInTheSky.jpg|thumb|250px|The destruction of the ''Lusankya'' in the final moments of "Operation Emperor's Spear"]]

Later in 12 ABY, it again served with the New Republic at the [[Orinda campaign]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> The ''Lusankya'' served in the New Republic fleet for nearly twenty years. It participated in the [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Battle of Borleias]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], where it helped protect the Republic stronghold on Borleias over the course of a month. After taking heavy damage due to attrition, it was decided that it would be abandoned. The ''Lusankya''{{'s}} crew was slowly taken off, while her weapons were dismantled and transferred to other warships. In their place, New Republic engineers installed a massive hollow spear, known as the [[Beltway (Lusankya)|Beltway]] that ran the length of the ship underneath her hull, which was then filled with high explosives. When the time came to finally evacuate Borleias, the ''Lusankya'' was sent to [[Operation Emperor's Spear|collide]] into the Domain Hul worldship. With a fleet of Republic warships escorting him, Commander [[Eldo Davip]] was able to reach the worldship and impale the ''Lusankya''{{'s}} hull into it before escaping the doomed ship. Both vessels were obliterated, allowing New Republic forces to withdraw among the chaos.

==Commanders and crew==
The names of most of the ''Lusankya''{{'s}} command officers during the [[Bacta War]] are known. With the exception of her [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] and the [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] commanding her two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] wings, most were apparently relatively junior in rank, perhaps a reflection of the irregular circumstances in which the ship had been put into service.
*[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Joak Drysso]] (commanding officer)
*[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Arl]] (starfighter commander)
*[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Waroen]] (captain's aide/sensor officer)
*[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gorev]] (gunnery officer)
*[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Rosion]] (Chief Navigator)
*[[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Yesti]] (communications officer)<ref name="BactaWar" />

Less is known about her officers and crew in New Republic service; it was commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] for several years beginning in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="CrimsonEmpire">''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire]]''</ref> and at the time of her destruction in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], it had been assigned a crew of politically inconvenient misfits led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Eldo Davip]].<ref name="RebelDream">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Lusankya'' was named after the [[Wikipedia:Lubyanka (KGB)|Lubyanka]], the infamous [[Wikipedia:KGB|KGB]] prison. Author [[Michael A. Stackpole]] stated, "I wanted it to sound much like the inescapable prison in Moscow because I wanted the ''Lusankya'' to be inescapable."<ref name="Mos Eisley">{{WebCite|url=http://www.moseisley.com/mos/iview/masinterview.html|text=Michael A. Stackpole Chat Transcript|archivedate=20010217122555}}</ref>

In his endnotes, Jason Fry, one of the writers for ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', cited the ''Lusankya''{{'s}} emergence from the cityscape of Coruscant as the goofiest thing in the entire [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]], also claiming that the only way it could get any goofier is if "[the ''Lusankya''{{'s}}] bridge crew were [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]], [[Reist]], and [[Waru]]."<ref name="Endnotes PT11">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/24881617404/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-11|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 11}}</ref>
